copy.headline: Arlington police searching for Tina BRANUM, wanted for unauthorized possession of certain copper or brass
copy.caption:
Arlington police are looking for Tina BRANUM, wanted for unauthorized possession of certain copper or brass material. Crime Stoppers is offering up to $2,000 for information leading to an arrest.

Call 817-469-TIPS (8477) or submit a tip at 469tips.com. You stay anonymous.
